name: agentica
headline: Agentica: TypeScript AI Function Calling Framework
short_description: Agentica is a TypeScript-based AI function calling framework that enhances capabilities with advanced compiler skills. It supports multi-agent systems and integrates with various AI models for efficient function execution.
author: wrtnlabs

sections.overview:
Agentica is a TypeScript-based framework designed for AI function calling and multi-agent system development. It provides advanced compiler skills that enhance the capabilities of AI models by enabling efficient function execution and orchestration. The framework supports integration with various AI models, allowing developers to build sophisticated agent systems that can leverage function calling for complex task automation. Agentica addresses the need for structured, type-safe function calling in AI applications, offering tools for reasoning tracking and validation feedback. It's built for developers working with Claude, Cursor, and similar AI platforms who need to implement reliable, multi-step AI-driven workflows.
Build AI-driven chatbots that can interact with users in natural language.
Integrate AI functions into existing applications to enhance their capabilities.
Create multi-agent systems that can collaborate on complex tasks efficiently.
Enhance retrieval-augmented generation workflows to improve information retrieval.
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install wrtnlabs/agentica`
`git clone https://github.com/wrtnlabs/agentica`
sections.usage:
```
Create a multi-agent system using Agentica to automate the process of [TASK]. Define the roles of each agent, their responsibilities, and how they will collaborate. Use OpenAI's GPT-4 model for natural language processing tasks. Ensure the system can handle [SPECIFIC INPUT] and provide [DESIRED OUTPUT].
```
Copy

```
To automate the process of customer support ticket resolution, we can create a multi-agent system using Agentica. The system will consist of three agents: the Ticket Triage Agent, the Issue Resolution Agent, and the Customer Communication Agent. The Ticket Triage Agent will be responsible for categorizing incoming tickets based on their urgency and complexity. It will use OpenAI's GPT-4 model to analyze the ticket descriptions and assign appropriate tags. The Issue Resolution Agent will then take the categorized tickets and work on resolving them. It will have access to a knowledge base of common issues and solutions, and it will use the GPT-4 model to generate potential solutions. The Customer Communication Agent will handle all interactions with the customer, providing updates on the status of their ticket and any necessary instructions. This agent will also use the GPT-4 model to generate natural language responses. The system can handle a variety of input types, including email, chat, and phone transcripts, and it can provide detailed resolution steps, customer updates, and escalation notifications as output.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
